purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 544 Mwanza (city code 1868); city-local registry basis and safe anonymous parcel-geometry access status.
registryBasis: Mwanza City Council’s own strategic plan documents its Urban Planning, Land and Natural Resources activity, city survey-and-mapping capacity, surveyed plots and title-deed preparation. The figures are historical aggregate evidence, so they establish city-local land survey/registry work but not current database coverage or a public parcel geometry route.

officialSources.observation: Mwanza City Council Strategic Plan 2016/17–2020/21 reports aggregate city work: 300 title deeds prepared from 12 wards, survey/mapping section capacity, and 18,000 surveyed plots in planned areas. No household/parcel-level rows were read or retained.
Official Mwanza City Council homepage returns a small static application shell referencing one public JavaScript bundle; no cadastre/map link is present in the shell. The bundle was not executed.
National Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi land-rent estimator is property/person specific and was excluded; no form was submitted or identifier entered.
